title: overdue-data
description:
This repository finds datasets that published papers say were deposited in a public archive but are still unreleased more than 18 months later, so the archives can follow them up.

Status: pilot, claimed, not peer reviewed.

In a claimed check of 500 open-access papers from January to March 2025, 10 of 694 ProteomeXchange datasets were still unreleased, and 1 of 987 GEO datasets was still private. The counts were confirmed from saved outputs and re-checked on 19 Oct 2026, and have not been reviewed by a person.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
